title: Place
description: One node of the place hierarchy in places.json (country > region > county > village). places.json is an array of these nodes sorted by id; the app rebuilds the tree from `parent`.

id.description: Slash-joined slug path, e.g. 'ro', 'ro/crisana', 'ro/crisana/bihor', 'ro/crisana/bihor/beius'. Unresolved localities live under '<country or xx>/unresolved/<slug>'.

name.description: Modern name (Romanian with diacritics for RO).

nameHistorical.description: Historical (usually Hungarian) name as printed on the source sites.

parent.description: Id of the parent node; null for a country.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, or null when unresolved.

coordSource.description: Where lat/lng came from. 'gazetteer-approx' coordinates are seeds to be verified.

songIds.description: Ids of songs located directly at this node (villages only; aggregates use counts).

confidence.description: Gazetteer confidence for the modern-name/coordinate match.
